messages.subject: Re: Creating a second Legend
parts:
Hi,

You could perhaps add a custom grob to the legend viewport (or more
reliably, in the plot area),

p <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg, colour=wt))
p + geom_point()

key <- simpleKey(letters[1:4], points = TRUE)
seekViewport("legend_box")
pushViewport(viewport(just=c(0.5, 0.8)))
draw.key(key, draw=TRUE)

I don't know if it's easy to produce a ggplot legend on its own, and
there are a number of problems with this approach.

HTH,

baptiste
